rows.name: Dis-And-Bark

rows.address: 98-1005 Moanalua Rd Ste 1411, Aiea, HI 96701; 685 Auahi St, Honolulu, HI 96813
rows.notes: Own site lists stores at Pearlridge (Uptown, near TJ Maxx) and SALT Kaka'ako (near Morning Brew). Kapolei Village Center store (4850 Kapolei Parkway #304) is shown as opening 8.1.26; I did not confirm it opened. Site says the online shop is closed for construction. Store hours are not on the own page, so none given. Also on the Hawaii Holiday Craft & Gift Fair's December 2025 vendor list, and KHON2 saw the booth at the Dec 2025 fair. Not confirmed for the 2026 fairs. Original 'pets' category is not an allowed value, so set to 'other'.

Vendor's own base not stated; side/neighborhood are the market's location.

rows.name: Good Mana
rows.description: Hawaiʻi-grown turmeric supplements, processed in Waimanalo
rows.made_where: Processed in a drying facility in Waimanalo, Hawaiʻi
rows.notes: Own site is live (2026 copyright) and sells online, with free U.S. shipping. A company press release (June 19, 2026) shows the phone number for Denny Kwock, who is president/co-founder, and the company's 2025 release says it is based in Waimanalo. Active in Mana Up's 2026 cohort (Hawaii News Now, Oct 19, 2026). The Nov 5 marketplace night comes from the first pass (Aloha State Daily, Sept 23, 2026); I did not re-open it, and the venue is not stated here. Earlier note said 'Oʻahu and Hilo'. The Hilo part is not confirmed; the Waimanalo base is, so it stays as an Oʻahu vendor. Mostly online; no regular retail or market schedule found. Spelling follows how the company writes it.

rows.name: Hua Mochi Aloha
rows.description: Fruit-stuffed mochi and acai bowls at KCC and Mililani farmers markets
rows.source_label: the Hawaiʻi Farm Bureau's market vendor list
rows.notes: Listed on the Hawaii Farm Bureau (market organizer) KCC page (Saturdays 7:30–11:00 AM, KCC Parking Lot B, 4303 Diamond Head Rd) and the Mililani page (Mililani High School, 95-1200 Meheula Pkwy). Organizer describes it as all-natural fruit-stuffed mochi, best known for strawberry, banana and seasonal fruit. 'Daifuku' is not on the organizer pages, so removed. Mililani Sunday comes from a Feb 13, 2026 Hawaii Mom Blog post, not the organizer page. Acai bowls and black natto come from a Marketspread vendor profile; an older HFBF post says it was formerly Daizu Tei and also made macadamia nut soft serve. Instagram handle written hua_mochialoha; bio says 'All natural strawberry mochi'. The blog also saw a pink food truck parked near Kahala Mall in Feb 2026; no schedule given.

rows.name: Island Banana Juice
rows.description: Banana smoothies from Hawaii-grown bananas and fruit sandwiches
rows.source_label: the Hawaiʻi Farm Bureau's market vendor list
rows.notes: Listed on the Hawaii Farm Bureau KCC page (Saturdays 7:30–11:00 AM) and Honolulu page (Wednesdays 4–7 PM, Neal S. Blaisdell Center, 777 Ward Ave), with Instagram @island_banana_juice. Honolulu Magazine's farmers market guide (about 19 days old) also names it at the Wednesday Honolulu market. Kailua Thursday 4–7 PM is from third-party pages built on the HFBF roster (Marketspread, Makekemaps); I did not check HFBF's Kailua page. Bananas are Hawaii-grown (a Marketspread profile names a Kāneʻohe farm). UH Mānoa's own food page lists an Island Banana Juice food truck at Food Truck Row, Tue/Wed/Fri 9 AM–2 PM (page undated).

rows.name: JAMS World
rows.description: Hawaii-made totes, bags and printed apparel; sells at craft fairs
rows.made_where: Hawaii (bags collection page says Made in Hawaii)
rows.notes: Own site is live and sells online (bags and apparel). The 2025 blog post says it had a booth at the 2025 Mele Kalikimaka Marketplace, but its event dates and hours do not match the organizer's Dec 13–14, 2025 schedule, so none given. The organizer's 2026 page lists the 11th year at the Blaisdell Center (Sat Dec 12, 9 AM–7 PM; Sun Dec 13, 9 AM–5 PM) and is taking vendor applications. No source states a 2026 JAMS World booth. A Jan 23, 2026 blog post gives outfit ideas for the Feb 2 Waikiki Makers Market but does not say they had a booth. Business location is not stated, so side, neighborhood and address are null. Confidence is medium because the own page shows the business is active but no current Oʻahu schedule is stated.
